query.question: A regional commission is planning its contribution to the follow-up to the World Summit on Sustainable Development. What action does the General Assembly call upon it to take?
query.answer: to take action to ensure the effective implementation of and follow-up to the commitments, programmes and time-bound targets adopted at the World Summit on Sustainable Development, and encourages them to report on concrete progress in that regard
